video.title: AI欧腐《被黑帮继兄掌控的我/Call Me Sugar Daddy, Racer: Driven by My Mafia Stepbrother》
video.desc:
He’s had me pinned for two years. Not in bed—on the Black Ridge circuit. Every time I was about to cross the finish line, he’d cut me off and wreck my cherry pies. Then my mom put on his father’s ring. My enemy became my stepbrother. He gave me a black card, rebuilt my car, and made me call him brother. I thought he was insane. Then I learned the truth— He wasn’t trying to ruin me. He was trying to keep me from dying on the same curve that killed my dad.
他压了我整整两年。不是在床上——是在 Black Ridge 赛道上。每次我快冲过终点线，他就把我截下来，毁掉我的好事。然后，我妈戴上了他父亲的戒指。我的死对头，成了我的继兄。他给了我一张黑卡，重造了我的赛车，还逼我叫他哥。我以为他疯了。直到我知道了真相——他不是想毁掉我。他是不想让我死在害死我爸的那个弯道上。
